name: prims_ts_dsv4_sparse_mla_h128_d512
description: PrimTS DSV4 sparse MLA decode over packed E4M3 queries and separate sliding-window / compressed KV pools with per-query physical routing; CSA and HCA differ only in routing metadata.  BF16 output.

swa_rows.description: Physical rows in the sliding-window pool.

compressed_rows.description: Physical rows in the compressed pool.

sparse_capacity.description: Routing slots per query (Kmax): 128 SWA + compressed.

sparse_indices.description: Physical routes: slots [0,128) address the SWA pool (-1 = inactive), the remaining slots address the compressed pool.

skip_corr_threshold.description: E4M3 skip-correction threshold in log2 units, in [0, 8].

check:
def standard_check(
    reference_outputs: Any,
    actual_outputs: Any,
    *,
    rtol: Optional[float] = None,
    atol: Optional[float] = None,
    max_mismatch_pct: float = 0.0,
    min_cos_sim: Optional[float] = 1.0 - 1e-3,
) -> bool:
    """Default trace correctness check used when a template does not override it."""
    from flashinfer.trace import default_check

    return default_check(
        reference_outputs,
        actual_outputs,
        rtol=rtol,
        atol=atol,
        max_mismatch_pct=max_mismatch_pct,
        min_cos_sim=min_cos_sim,
    )
